key_insight: SWE-Serve benchmarks whether coding agents can make production-correct inference-serving changes, not just pass local unit tests.
engineering_relevance: It is directly relevant for teams building LLM agents for serving stacks because it measures end-to-end correctness across model support, runtime execution, and public APIs.
method: 53 repository-grounded tasks from real SGLang production changes
Six inference-engineering task families, runnable on CPU or a single H100 GPU
Hidden functional/regression tests plus E2E serving tests and calibrated performance gates
evidence_signal: Across 11 models and 31 configurations, the best result reached 75% mean pass@1, while E2E tests rejected about one-third of patches that otherwise passed non-E2E checks.
watch_item: The benchmark is tied to SGLang and a specific production-serving stack, so generalization to other systems may be limited.
paper_title: SWE-Serve: Benchmarking Agentic Engineering For Production Inference Serving
